scope: Only closed corrected wo_shift seeds0,1,2; no full3 statistics repeated; no component scientific acceptance
prediction: Fixed arithmetic mean of original and shifted counts before NumPy ties-to-even rounding; retain both views and full raw predictions
delta_sign: NMAE removal_minus_full: positive favors full. OBO full_minus_removal: positive favors full. Relative removal degradation divides by full mean.
bootstrap_scope: Only new wo_shift-vs-corrected-full contrasts; existing group/bootstrap functions reused exactly. Conditional on fitted models; source clusters from frozen manifest.
bootstrap_mc_note: 10000 draws yield about14 samples per Bonferroni18 extreme tail; no p-values or confirmatory significance claims.
limitations: Known-source-disjoint training does not resolve inherited evaluation-label conflicts or unknown overlap.

shift_factorial_note: Read views.original versus views.two_view_mean for shift-trained full and no-shift-trained removal; shift-only is also retained. No selected-best-view comparison.
